purpose: Canonical project target-zone county definition for native-range threshold decisions.
guardrails: Use only these counties when calculating target_zone_count.
Evidence from counties outside this list may be retained as context but must not count toward the threshold.
Taxon concept and synonym mapping must be resolved before county evidence is counted.
source_note: Explicit project target-zone definition supplied by the user on 2026-09-30. Supersedes older or inferred county lists.
